source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Two skills are both described as "turn text into useful documents," but one makes lecture notes and the other makes meeting summaries. What edit most directly clarifies selection?

options.text: Give both skills the same shorter name and description
options.feedback: Making their identifying guidance even more alike preserves the ambiguity instead of explaining their different uses.

options.text: Move both complete procedures into a single shared description
options.feedback: More procedural detail is not the same as a clear boundary. The description should distinguish purposes without absorbing both full procedures.

options.text: Describe each output and the kind of source it handles
options.feedback: Specific outcomes and use conditions distinguish the two procedures when an agent matches a request to a skill.

options.text: Add the latest generated document to each scripts folder
options.feedback: Generated documents are outputs, not executable routines, and moving them does not clarify when each skill applies.
